govdocs-archive_org-nsia-MeekJeff_Meek_J: This letter on the John Joerg manuscript — April 28, 1979 — is an archive note. Manuscripts pass through many hands. The letter may hold a clue. The file belongs to the literary archive. The item is a fragment of correspondence.
the-love-tiff: Molière's early comedy of lovers' quarrels follows two couples through misunderstandings, pride, and jealousy toward a happy ending. Written when the playwright was finding his comic voice, Le Dépit amoureux already shows his gift for turning human folly into laughter. A delightful romp for lovers of classic French comedy.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-baroness-von-: A 1913 entry on Annette von Droste-Hülshoff — the great German poetess. Franz Jostes honors her Westphalian verse. Her Judenbuche is a masterwork. The moors inspired her somber song. Germany's greatest woman poet. Her Hülshoff castle keeps her relics.
